prompt: Realistic handheld smartphone mockumentary video, vertical, filmed by a coworker in a modern beauty salon at night. A real capuchin monkey named Paco, black apron, towel on his shoulder, tired, files a client's nails slowly. Spanish from Spain dialogue, Paco has a tired deadpan deep male voice with lip sync. Off-camera woman coworker: "Paco, cierra ya, que son las nueve." Paco, without looking up: "Una más, reina. Este mes vamos a tope." Coworker: "¿Y cuánto has ganado?" Paco pauses, slowly turns and looks straight at the camera: "Muchísimo." Coworker: "¿Cuánto es muchísimo?" Paco: "Lo sé porque estoy cansadísimo." Then Paco pulls a shoebox full of crumpled paper receipts from under the table and shakes it at the camera: "Las cuentas, aquí. Algo habrá." Sarcastic deadpan humor, quiet salon ambience, sound of the nail file. No music, no subtitles, no text on screen.
